messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
そしてすべての欲望を抱く雌狼 か細さの中で重く見えるほど、 そして多くの人々をすでに悲しみの中で生きさせた、

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Japanese Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Ed | coordinating conjunction “And” | そして | “and” | OK | | una | indefinite article (fem. sg.) | *(omitted)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | lupa | “she‑wolf”, subject of the clause | 雌狼 | “she‑wolf” | OK | | che | relative pronoun “who” | *(implicit in the relative clause)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | di | preposition “with / of” (linking “all cravings”) | の (as part of すべての) | “of” | OK | | tutte | universal quantifier “all” | すべての | “all” | OK | | brame | plural noun “cravings, desires” | 欲望 | “desires” | OK | | sembrava | imperfect copular verb “seemed” | 見えるほど | “seemed” | OK | | carca | adjective “laden, heavy” | 重く | “heavy / laden” | OK | | ne | preposition “in” (locative) | の中で | “in” | OK | | la | definite article (fem. sg.) | *(omitted)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | sua | possessive adjective “her” | *(omitted)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | magrezza | noun “meagreness, thinness” | か細さ | “thinness” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | そして | “and” | OK | | molte | quantitative adjective “many” | 多くの | “many” | OK | | genti | plural noun “folk, people” | 人々 | “people” | OK | | fé | past‑remote of *fare* “made, caused” | 生きさせた | “made live” | OK | | già | temporal adverb “already” | すでに | “already” | OK | | viver | infinitive “to live” | 生きさせた (as part of the causative) | “to live” | OK | | grame | noun “grief, forlornness” | 悲しみ | “sadness / grief” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *una*, *la*, *sua*, *che* – Japanese naturally omits articles and explicit relative pronouns in this construction. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Japanese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 49: - Original: そしてすべての欲望を抱く雌狼、 - Issue: none - Corrected: そしてすべての欲望を抱く雌狼、
- Line 50: - Original: か細さの中で重く見えるほど、 - Issue: missing possessive “her” (her meagreness) - Corrected: 彼女のか細さの中で重く見えるほど、
- Line 51: - Original: そして多くの人々をすでに悲しみの中で生きさせた、 - Issue: adverb placement; “already” should precede the verb phrase - Corrected: そしてすでに多くの人々を悲しみの中で生きさせた、
```text そしてすべての欲望を抱く雌狼、 彼女のか細さの中で重く見えるほど、 そしてすでに多くの人々を悲しみの中で生きさせた、 ```
